parsed.summary: The PR introduces redundant code and does not address the intended optimization.

issues.description: The PR contains multiple redundant blocks of code that perform the same operation. This violates the principle of minimal change and makes the codebase harder to maintain.
The code is repetitive and lacks clarity, making it difficult to understand and maintain.
There are no tests added to verify the new functionality or to ensure that the optimization works as intended.
